name: form-field
summary: Renders a labelled native input or textarea with optional disabled state, persistent help, and explicit invalid-state wiring.

agent.useWhen: An app-owned form needs editable text, email, URL, number, password, search, date, telephone, or multiline text with a visible label and optional persistent hint or error.
agent.avoidWhen: The value is selected from a closed option set, uploaded as a file, edited as rich content, or needs a date-picker widget. Do not use to create a form, command, route, or validation workflow.

invariants: The app owns its surrounding form, command, route, submission transport, domain validation, and checked page-field binding; this component only emits one native editable control.
Every control has an explicit stable ID, a non-reserved form name, and a visible label associated by for/id. Values and all user-facing content are escaped plain text; an omitted value is empty.

Hint and error descriptions use deterministic IDs derived from the control ID and are listed in aria-describedby in matching order. An error is visible and sets aria-invalid=true; no error omits aria-invalid.

required, readonly, and disabled are native boolean attributes. A disabled control is unavailable for interaction and is omitted from native form submission, including command submissions; do not use it when a command must receive that named value. No hidden fields, raw attributes, Datastar expressions, forms, routes, commands, or JavaScript are emitted.

Textarea is a distinct field kind, supports rows from 2 through 40 (default 3), preserves permitted newlines, and does not accept inputType. Input rows are invalid. Autocomplete is supported for both control kinds.
maxLength is optional and must be an integer from 1 through 65535. It is supported for textarea and text, email, URL, password, search, and telephone inputs, but rejected for number and date inputs.

Hint and error values, when provided, must contain non-whitespace plain text. Placeholder may intentionally be empty. Input values reject control characters; textarea values preserve line breaks and tabs while rejecting other control characters.
The fragment contains exactly one [[attributes]], [[label]], [[control]], and [[description]] slot. The renderer performs single-pass slot expansion without interpreting slot-like user text.
